meta.description: Editing long-form YouTube essays, podcasts, and short-form videos. Structure, pacing, motion graphics, color and audio mastering.
meta.ogTitle: .fleur — Video Editor for YouTube, Podcasts & Reels
meta.ogDescription: Video editing for YouTube, podcasts and Reels. Telegram communication, timecode-based revisions.

hero.title: Video Editing for YouTube & Socials That Holds Attention and Grows Your Audience
hero.sub: fleur provides video editing for YouTube, podcasts, Reels and Shorts. I shape the structure, remove unnecessary pauses and mistakes, add titles and motion graphics, and take care of colour and sound. You send the footage and your notes. We communicate through Telegram, and revisions are handled using timecodes.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.subtitle: Price depends on the project, calculated after reviewing your material.
factors: Volume of videos (ongoing collaboration discussed individually)
pricing.ctaText: Send a link to your channel, a sample video, and approximate duration. Cost and turnaround are shared after reviewing the material.

process.title: How the work goes
process.subtitle: We communicate on Telegram, no unnecessary calls

steps.title: Brief & footage
steps.desc: You send raw footage, references, and your vision. I review the material and provide the timeline and cost.

steps.title: Rough cut & pacing
steps.desc: I build the structure, remove pauses and slips, and share the initial cut.

steps.title: Graphics, color & sound
steps.desc: Motion titles and animated diagrams, color grading in DaVinci, audio mastering.

steps.title: Revisions & final file
steps.desc: Timecode-based revisions, 2 rounds included, then I deliver the final master file.

items.title: Thoughtful structure
items.desc: I trim the unnecessary, shape the sequencing, and maintain steady pacing so the video flows naturally from start to finish.

items.title: Visual style of your channel
items.desc: I match your references, brand identity, and tone. Titles, motion graphics, and animation enhance the story without distracting.

items.title: Clean sound and visual grade
items.desc: I refine colors, remove unwanted background noise, level volume, and ensure speech clarity. Detail makes the viewing experience comfortable.

items.title: Transparent workflow
items.desc: You send the footage and notes; I handle the editing. We communicate on Telegram and discuss revisions by timecodes — without endless calls.

reviews.title: Client Feedback
reviews.subtitle: What creators say about working together

items.a: Long-form video — from $200. Final cost depends on duration, raw footage volume, graphics complexity, and urgency. I provide the exact price and timeline after reviewing the footage.
I provide the turnaround time after reviewing the footage. It depends on video length, volume of raw material, and complexity of graphics.
You review the video via a private link and share timecode-based notes via Telegram. 2 comprehensive revision rounds are included in each project.

items.q: How do I send raw footage?
items.a: Via any cloud storage: Google Drive, Dropbox, or Telegram.

contact.title: Tell me about your upcoming project
contact.sub: Reach out via Telegram or email. Let's discuss your timeline, pacing, and target launch date.
contact.briefHelper: What to send for a quick estimate: channel link, reference video, raw footage duration, and your target deadline.
